sys_script.description: Custody Trade Case closure and Flow cancellation on receiving subsequent FOL event in the same BPI sub-group if the Previous Case Closure Stage in True in the respective Business Process Stage record. As part of story -MSSCUSTODY-1415, updated the BR trigger condition to execute only when Ignore case cancellation core is false except for Trade Cancelled. As per the story-1727, built the logic to trigger the business rule for the event that came before the ignore case cancellation core field set to false
sys_script.name: MSSCustody Core Case and Flow Cancel
